summary: Realign GCP org-scoped service account permissions for SRE on-call to enforce least privilege
description: Issue summary: Request to audit and reduce privileges for several GCP service accounts currently used by SRE on-call runbooks. Background: During a recent security review we identified multiple org-scoped service accounts and one project-level account that have permissions beyond the documented runbook requirements (resourcemanager.projects.get, iam.serviceAccounts.actAs, broad storage admin roles). Impact: If not remediated, elevated permissions increase blast radius for on-call escalations and third-party troubleshooting. Request: 1) Inventory the active service accounts used by SRE/Oncall across redwood-prod-* projects in the org. 2) Produce a table mapping actions required by runbooks to minimal IAM roles/permissions. 3) Create and apply curated, least-privilege role bindings (use custom roles where necessary) and replace broad roles (e.g., roles/storage.admin). 4) Provide a rollback plan and a short verification script for SRE to run during deployment windows. Acceptance criteria: - All targeted service accounts have only the permissions required by documented runbooks. - No increase in P0/P1 pager events after the change (monitoring window 48 hours). - Runbooks updated with exact service account names and verification steps. - Confluence page with the new role matrix and a short migration checklist.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - administrative privilege inventory and remediation task
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11: Initial inventory executed using gcloud iam service-accounts list across redwood-prod-* projects. Found 7 service accounts tied to SRE automation jobs and 3 human-operated service accounts used by Legacy Debug tooling.
2026-03-12: Permission export performed with gcloud iam roles list and policy bindings dump. Observed roles/storage.admin and roles/owner on two service accounts provisioned pre-2023.
2026-03-12: Cross-checked runbook steps that require storage read/write; determined some jobs only need objectViewer + objectCreator, not full storage.admin.
Hypothesis: Historical convenience granted broad roles during incident responses and never tightened.
